definitions.name: L2A.MOD
definitions.body: 'MB' BIND 'MA' BIND MA MA MB DIV FLOOR MB MUL SUB
definitions.note: a b -> a - b * floor(a/b); lifts over a Vector in either operand

definitions.name: L2A.SUMBY
definitions.body: 'SBV' BIND 'SBK' BIND SBK SBV GROUP 'SBG' BIND SBG KEYS SBG VALUES [ 0 [ ADD ] FOLD ] MAP RECORD
definitions.note: keys Vector, numbers Vector -> Record from each key to the sum of its numbers, keys in first-appearance order

definitions.name: L2A.BYNAME
definitions.body: 'LBV' BIND LBV [ 0 GET ] MAP LBV [ 1 GET ] MAP L2A.SUMBY
definitions.note: Vector of [ name amount ] pairs -> Record from name to summed amount, first-appearance order

definitions.name: L2A.UNWORDS
definitions.body: 'UW' BIND UW 0 GET UW 1 DROP [ 'UX' BIND ' ' UX 2 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: non-empty Vector of Strings -> one String joined by single spaces

definitions.name: L2A.CAP
definitions.body: CHARS 'CC' BIND CC 0 GET UPPER CC 1 DROP JOIN LOWER 2 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: non-empty String -> first character upper case, the rest lower case

definitions.name: L2A.DIVISORS
definitions.body: 'DN' BIND 1 DN RANGE [ 'DD' BIND DN DD L2A.MOD 0 EQ ] FILTER
definitions.note: positive integer -> ascending Vector of its positive divisors

definitions.name: L2A.ISPRIME
definitions.body: 'IN' BIND IN IN 1 IN RANGE L2A.MOD 1 MIN 0 [ ADD ] FOLD SUB 2 EQ
definitions.note: positive integer -> TRUE when it has exactly two positive divisors

definitions.name: L2A.PRIMES
definitions.body: 'PN' BIND 1 PN RANGE [ L2A.ISPRIME ] FILTER
definitions.note: positive integer n -> ascending Vector of the primes up to n (empty for 1)

definitions.name: L2A.BINARY
definitions.body: 'BN' BIND [ 64 32 16 8 4 2 1 ] [ BN GT NOT ] FILTER [ 'BP' BIND BN BP DIV FLOOR 2 L2A.MOD STR ] MAP JOIN
definitions.note: integer 1..127 -> its base-2 digits as a String, no leading zeros

definitions.name: L2A.CSTEP
definitions.body: 'CE' BIND 'CA' BIND CA 0 GET 'CV' BIND CA 1 GET 'CK' BIND CV 2 L2A.MOD 0 EQ 'CEV' BIND CV 2 DIV CV 3 MUL 1 ADD CEV SELECT 'CNX' BIND CV 1 EQ 'CDN' BIND CV CNX CDN SELECT CK CK 1 ADD CDN SELECT 2 COLLECT
definitions.note: FOLD step on [ value steps ]: one Collatz move and a count, unchanged once value is 1

definitions.name: L2A.COLLATZ
definitions.body: 'CN' BIND 1 150 RANGE CN 0 2 COLLECT [ L2A.CSTEP ] FOLD 1 GET
definitions.note: positive integer (needing at most 150 steps) -> Collatz steps to reach 1

definitions.name: L2A.FIBS
definitions.body: 'FK' BIND 1 FK RANGE 0 1 2 COLLECT [ 'FE' BIND 'FA' BIND FA 1 GET FA 0 GET FA 1 GET ADD 2 COLLECT ] SCAN [ 0 GET ] MAP
definitions.note: k -> Vector [ F(1) .. F(k) ] of Fibonacci numbers

definitions.name: L2A.FIBINDEX
definitions.body: 'FN' BIND 30 L2A.FIBS [ FN LT ] FILTER LENGTH 1 ADD
definitions.note: positive integer n (up to F(30)) -> smallest k with F(k) >= n

definitions.name: L2A.ORDERS
definitions.body: JSON-DECODE 'orders' GET
definitions.note: JSON String with an orders array -> Vector of order Records

definitions.name: L2A.REVENUE
definitions.body: L2A.ORDERS [ 'price' GET NIL? NOT ] FILTER [ 'OQ' BIND OQ 'qty' GET OQ 'price' GET MUL ] MAP 0 [ ADD ] FOLD
definitions.note: orders JSON String -> total qty*price over orders that have a price

definitions.name: L2A.QTYBYSKU
definitions.body: L2A.ORDERS 'OO' BIND OO [ 'sku' GET ] MAP OO [ 'qty' GET ] MAP L2A.SUMBY
definitions.note: orders JSON String -> Record from sku to summed qty, first-appearance order

definitions.name: L2A.TAGCOUNTS
definitions.body: L2A.ORDERS [ 'tags' HAS? ] FILTER [ 'tags' GET UNIQUE ] MAP [ ] [ CONCAT ] FOLD TALLY
definitions.note: orders JSON String -> Record from tag to number of orders carrying it

definitions.name: L2A.MEDIAN
definitions.body: SORT 'MS' BIND MS LENGTH 'ML' BIND MS ML 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET MS ML 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
definitions.note: non-empty numeric Vector -> median (mean of the two middle values when even)

definitions.name: L2A.ABS
definitions.body: 'AB' BIND AB AB -1 MUL MAX
definitions.note: number or numeric Vector -> absolute value, lane by lane

definitions.name: L2A.MAD
definitions.body: 'MV' BIND MV MV L2A.MEDIAN SUB L2A.ABS L2A.MEDIAN
definitions.note: numeric Vector -> median absolute deviation from the median

definitions.name: L2A.MEAN
definitions.body: 'AV' BIND AV 0 [ ADD ] FOLD AV LENGTH DIV
definitions.note: non-empty numeric Vector -> arithmetic mean

definitions.name: L2A.VAR
definitions.body: 'VV' BIND VV VV L2A.MEAN SUB 'VD' BIND VD VD MUL L2A.MEAN
definitions.note: non-empty numeric Vector -> population variance

definitions.name: L2A.MOVING3
definitions.body: 'MVT' BIND MVT -2 DROP MVT 1 DROP -1 DROP ADD MVT 2 DROP ADD 3 DIV
definitions.note: numeric Vector (3+) -> means of every three consecutive numbers

definitions.name: L2A.TRIMMED
definitions.body: SORT 1 DROP -1 DROP L2A.MEAN
definitions.note: numeric Vector (3+) -> mean after dropping one smallest and one largest

definitions.name: L2A.RANGEV
definitions.body: SORT 'RS' BIND RS -1 GET RS 0 GET SUB
definitions.note: non-empty numeric Vector -> largest minus smallest

definitions.name: L2A.NORMALIZE
definitions.body: 'NV' BIND NV SORT 'NS' BIND NS 0 GET 'NMN' BIND NS -1 GET NMN SUB 'NW' BIND NV NMN SUB NW DIV
definitions.note: numeric Vector, not all equal -> each (x - min) / (max - min)
